name: mise-task-managing
description: Use this skill when working with mise task runners, managing project tasks, creating Python CLI task scripts, setting up mise configuration, or implementing semantic versioning. Handles Typer/Click-based task scripts, TOML configuration, and module-based task organization.

commands.name: mise:initialize
commands.description: Initialize mise in a project that doesn't include mise, or refactor existing mise setup. Creates .mise/tasks/ directory structure, main.toml orchestration file, and optional root mise.toml for tool versions.

commands.name: mise:taskify
commands.description: Codify a workflow or set of steps into a Python task script (Typer or Click) and expose it as a mise task. Handles domain identification, script creation, TOML configuration, and testing.

commands.name: mise:versioning
commands.description: Implement semantic versioning logic in .mise/tasks/versioning.py with three mise tasks: version:bump (patch), version:minor, and version:major. Syncs versions across multiple files (package.json, pyproject.toml, etc.).

author: Jarad DeLorenzo
